function.name: submit_callback_request
function.description: Ask the workshop to call the customer back when the AI cannot resolve the request or the caller wants human assistance. Call it after one short confirmation of the number and reason.

phone.description: Confirmed phone number for the workshop to call back, digits only, e.g. 0701234567, or the caller ID exactly as shown if the caller chose it, e.g. +46701234567. Never template text or placeholders.

registrationNumber.description: Vehicle registration number only if it was read back to and confirmed by the caller, uppercase without spaces, e.g. ABC123.

reason.description: Why the caller wants to be called back, in Swedish, based only on the conversation, e.g. 'Vill boka däckskifte, vill prata med personal'. If the caller only asked for a person, 'Kunden vill prata med personal'.

notes.description: Other relevant details the caller gave. Omit if none.
